reason: The README clearly describes a browser stock-monitoring overlay with real-time market data, charts, watchlist groups, target-price markers, and analysis shortcuts; visualization is the primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中提供可折叠的 A 股自选股行情面板，支持实时数据、分时与 K 线图表、分组管理及目标价标记。
summaries.en: Adds a collapsible A-share watchlist panel to the DeepSeek Harness web interface with real-time data, intraday and candlestick charts, grouping, and target-price markers.

capabilities: Provides a draggable, collapsible browser overlay for monitoring selected A-share stocks
Fetches real-time quotes, minute data, and candlestick data from Tencent Finance endpoints
Reads stock configuration from ~/.stocking/settings.json and persists settings in browser localStorage
Copies bundled skills into the user skills directory unless disabled by configuration
Creates DSH conversations and sends predefined stock-analysis prompts
